title: Disney Cute All Over Mickey Mouse Soup/Cereal Bowl, Black White Red
descriptionText: This Disneyana collectible features Mickey Mouse in an all-over design on a black, white, and red background. The R SQUARED ZRIKE BRANDS bowl is perfect for soup or cereal, and is sure to add a touch of whimsy to any meal. The item was manufactured in China and is not a modified piece. It is a great addition to any Disney or Mickey Mouse collection.
